column3: NASB renders “takes place” as “is coming” and “to be crucified” as “for crucifixion.”
NASB follows the critical text without “and the scribes”; “courtyard” is rendered “court.”
NASB renders “fragrant oil” as “perfume” and adds “at the table.”
NASB has “the disciples” without “His,” like the critical text.
NASB renders “a beautiful work” as “a good deed.”
“To bury Me” is rendered “to prepare Me for burial.”
“Proclaimed” is rendered “preached,” and “for a memorial” is “in memory.”
NASB has no “to Him,” like the critical text.
NASB renders “with you” as “at your house” and adds “am to.”
“Dish” is rendered “bowl,” and NASB adds “is the one.”
NASB follows the critical text (“gave”) and renders “having blessed” as “after a blessing.”
NASB follows the critical text with “the covenant” (Textus Receptus: “the new covenant”).
